## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ff701a6e513296512f9d602beb5e9b9dded57370`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md + packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.ts, packages/objectql/src/home-amount-recompute.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/recompute-home-amounts.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts, docs/adr/0134-env-side-scim-provisioning.md (the cited code and records, read on `origin/main` at `561d532c`, not reviewed)

Governing text: card #30676 body and comments (unblock note 6675290331 narrows it to the ADR note; the `skills/**` line is #30740's), claim 6675374172, ruling 6670707546 on #8345 and the seat sign-off beside it (6670841501), dev report 6675653199, the PR body, and PR #30737's merged tree (`e2bcd5c1`, an ancestor of both the branch point `1371b9d8` and today's `main`). Read-only shape held: `git diff 561d532c4...ff701a6e` (one file, +25/-0, one hunk, no merge of `main`), the cited files via `git show`, the card and ruling through the REST API, the head's check-runs through the API. PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The note records the ruling and nothing beyond it.** Letter C, A now and B as its own card; A's five tree facts; B's shape in one sentence; the four not-chosen shapes with their reasons; the item-5 interim; the item left open on its B half. Each sentence was matched to a sentence of 6670707546 or to the merged code. What the ruling leaves to the B card is left there: no gate is named (the ruling recommends `setup.write` and names `manage_metadata` as the alternative; #30675's body carries both, and the note names neither), no SDK method, no route-ledger row, no 409 remedy text, no Setup button. Nothing is adjudicated that the ruling did not. **Right.**
2. **Not chosen, one line each, matches the ruling's "Not chosen" paragraph.** A alone / cloud tenant reads a remedy it cannot run; B alone / self-hosted multi-organization CLI still writes one code everywhere; D (operations forever) / contrary to the `_migrate-stored` rationale and ADR-0134 D2 (read: "no shape in which a cloud-managed deployment and a self-hosted one differ on this"); deriving the code from `localization.currency` / D8 rule 4, a `dynamic` tenant currency has no history. Same four, same reasons, no fifth. **Right.**
3. **Every anchor resolves on `main` to what the note claims, and the three cited files are unchanged since `e2bcd5c1`.** `record-currency-backfill.ts#backfillRecordCurrencyCodes`: `resolveScope` then, with neither scope option, a read-only `walkCodelessRows`, more than one named organization among them throws `organizationsRefusal`, else the apply walk. `#resolveScope`: the option pair and a blank id throw `VALIDATION_ERROR` with `field: 'organizationId'`; an object storing no `organization_id` throws before any read (the note keeps the ruling's words and does not restate that code, as the PR body says). `#organizationsRefusal`: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `status` and `httpStatus` 400, `field: 'organizationId'`, the message listing each organization's codeless count and the error carrying `organizations`. `#walkCodelessRows`: `{ ...SYSTEM_CTX, tenantId: organizationId }` on the find and on every `engine.update`, `where: { organization_id }` on a scoped walk, counts per organization in `report.organizations`. `record-currency-codes.ts#MigrateRecordCurrencyCodes`: `org` and `all-organizations` each declare `exclusive` of the other; the catch prints each organization's count and the remedy naming both flags. `home-amount-recompute.ts#recomputeHomeAmounts`: optional `organizationId`, the scoped context and filter, and nothing refuses its absence (its docblock: "nothing here writes a value the caller chose, so there is nothing to refuse"); the CLI's `recompute-home-amounts.ts` hands `--org` through as `organizationId`. **All six claims hold.**
4. **"More than one organization among the rows" is the tree, not a new ruling.** The ruling says "a database holding more than one organization"; PR #30737 reads it off the object's own rows (its acceptance note) and the note says what landed, naming the PR. Recording the merged reading of a ruled sentence is the ADR's job here, and the ruling's own single-organization clause is unchanged by it. **Right.**
5. **The interim is an interim.** It is headed "Interim, not the answer", bounded "until #30675 lands", and the closing sentence keeps the item open on its B half. That is the ruling's item 5 verbatim in substance and the card's second task. **Right.**
6. **Dates.** The ruling comment was created 2026-11-05 (API `created_at`), the note cites it so; the note is dated 2026-11-06, the day of the commit; `e2bcd5c1` is PR #30737's merge commit and card #30674 is its card. **Right.**
7. **Voice and form.** The note sits under item 13 after the 2026-10-30 note, as the record's other items stack theirs; it opens `*Note (date):*`, links the ruling as `[\`id\`](url) on #8345` like the 2026-10-30 note and D9's, names the landing PR with its short sha like every 2026-11-04 note, and anchors symbols `path#symbol` with backticked `#continuation` on the same line, the form the record already uses (item 3's `#divideToPlaces, #divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero, #toScaledDecimal`). Bold inside a note has D9's precedent. No Status, Provenance or Evidence line is touched; no decision is reversed (Prime Directive #13); the item carries the ruling's id so the decision is findable. **Matches.**

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body, `skip-changeset` on the PR: a `docs/adr/**`-only diff publishes nothing from any released package, so no changeset is owed and no consumer-facing surface moves. Check Changeset and the Governed Surface Queue Guard both concluded `success` on this head. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions: []`. The dev's four deviations are all about the worktree and the local gate run (harness-pinned worktree, the verify-lock wrapper refused, one command split, `node_modules` installed), none about the diff; the one family NOT MEASURED locally (`check:doc-formula-expressions`) runs in the Lint workflow on this head. `skills/**` untouched, as the unblock note requires. The PR body's 需要您做的 line and the card both say Tier H approval by os-zhuang or hotlong follows the seat's ACCEPT. Author note: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no outside author.

### ④ Design judgment

1. **The ADR against its first consumer.** The note's first consumer is the B card's dev and the maintainer reading item 13 to learn what the backfill does today and what is still owed: the note gives both, cites the code a REST door must reuse (`backfillRecordCurrencyCodes`, "calling the same engine function"), and keeps the door's open details (gate, SDK, ledger row) on #30675, so nothing here pre-decides what that card's review will judge. **Holds.**
2. **Against its execution plan.** The ruling's execution paragraph puts the ADR record in the Tier H close-out card and the `skills/**` line beside it; the unblock note moved that line to #30740, and the diff follows it: no second PR collides on `field-types.md`. The item stays open, so the B card's landing owes one more dated note and nothing else. **Holds.**
3. **Tried to break it.** A reader who takes the interim for the answer: the bold heading and "until #30675 lands" refuse that reading. A reader who looks for the `localization.currency` reference the ruling allowed in the refusal: the note says it is not read, which is the merged tree (PR #30737 chose not to show it, its acceptance note says so; `walkCodelessRows` reads `id`, `organization_id`, the amount and the code field and nothing else). A B-card dev who reads the note for the gate: finds none, goes to the card. No must-fix found.

**Check-runs on this head** (API, at review time): 43 runs, 20 `success`, 20 `skipped` (the opt-in and matrix placeholders, UI, build and dogfood rows a docs-only diff filters out), 3 still running (Test Core 1/8, Type Check · consumer gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates), 0 red. Green: Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Auto Label, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, the three scoped lints, Type Check · source gates / workspace / debt ledger, Test UI, filter. Landing precondition ② (every check green) stays the dispatching seat's to confirm once the three conclude; nothing read here predicts a red.

Should-fix (non-blocking, prose only):
(a) The sentence "No organization's `localization.currency` is read, in the refusal or anywhere in the run (D8 rule 4)." follows the recompute sentence, and the recompute reads each organization's home currency by design (`recomputeHomeAmounts` calls `serving.homeCurrency` per organization); "the refusal" ties it to the backfill, but the nearer antecedent is the recompute. Exact text: "No organization's `localization.currency` is read by the backfill, in its refusal or anywhere in its run (D8 rule 4)."
(b) The header's Evidence line accounts for the readings at `cdec7473` and `f68b47ca` and not for this note's, read at `1371b9d8`; the note names `e2bcd5c1`, which fixes the tree, so this is a bookkeeping clause for the seat at ACCEPT or the next note batch. The PR body's "its earlier Open-item notes amend none of them either" is true of the 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-31 notes and not of the 2026-11-04 batch, which added the `f68b47ca` clause in `b7075d99`.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-30676-adr-0144-item-13-note`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4cytLmJxfAmgPVjUbbW`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Fresh record for the new head. The prior PASS 6675745144 named `ff701a6e513296512f9d602beb5e9b9dded57370` and does not carry; it is the baseline for everything the delta leaves alone. Governing text is unchanged: card #30676 and its comments (unblock note 6675290331, claim 6675374172), ruling 6670707546 on #8345, dev report 6675653199, the PR body, PR #30737's merged tree (`e2bcd5c1`). Read-only shape held: `git diff ff701a6e 6e350b6d` and `git diff 561d532c4...6e350b6d`, the cited files via `git show`, the head's check-runs through the API. PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

**The delta.** One commit on top of `ff701a6e`, no merge of `main` (merge-base with `origin/main` is still `1371b9d8`). One file, one line, +1/-1: the sentence "No organization's `localization.currency` is read, in the refusal or anywhere in the run (D8 rule 4)." now reads "No organization's `localization.currency` is read by the backfill, in its refusal or anywhere in its run (D8 rule 4)." — the prior record's should-fix (a), applied verbatim. The PR's diff against `main` is still the one file, +25/-0, one hunk under Open item 13. Every other line of the note is byte-identical to the reviewed head, so baseline ① items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 and ④ items 1 and 2 hold at this head unchanged; ① item 3 and ④ item 3 are re-read below where the sentence touches them.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Ruling coverage, nothing beyond it.** Unchanged by the diff: letter C, A's tree facts, B in one sentence with no gate named, the four not-chosen shapes with the ruling's reasons, the item-5 interim, the item open on its B half. **Holds.**
2. **Not chosen matches the ruling's paragraph.** Unchanged by the diff. **Holds.**
3. **Anchors and the amended sentence.** The six `file#symbol` anchors are untouched and resolve on `main` as before (the three cited files are unchanged since `e2bcd5c1`). The amended sentence now binds to the backfill alone: `record-currency-backfill.ts` reads `id`, `organization_id`, the amount field and the code field and nothing else in `walkCodelessRows`, `organizationsRefusal` carries counts only, and its docblock states "No organization's `localization.currency` is read here". The recompute, whose `recomputeHomeAmounts` calls `serving.homeCurrency` per organization, is no longer a possible antecedent. The ruling's own clause (the refusal MAY show the currency as a reference, never written) is still recorded as the tree's choice, which PR #30737's acceptance note states. **Right.**
4. **"More than one organization among the rows" is the tree, not a new ruling.** Unchanged by the diff. **Holds.**
5. **The interim is an interim.** Unchanged by the diff. **Holds.**
6. **Dates.** The note's date 2026-11-06 is still the day of both commits; the ruling date 2026-11-05 and `e2bcd5c1` are unchanged. **Holds.**
7. **Voice and form.** The amended line is 129 characters, within the record's existing line lengths; no Status, Provenance or Evidence line is touched. **Holds.**

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset` on a `docs/adr/**`-only diff that publishes nothing. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions: []`; the dev's deviations are unchanged and about the worktree only. `skills/**` still untouched. The PR body's 需要您做的 line still says Tier H approval by os-zhuang or hotlong follows the seat's ACCEPT. Author note: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no outside author.

### ④ Design judgment

1. **The ADR against its first consumer.** Unchanged by the diff. **Holds.**
2. **Against its execution plan.** Unchanged by the diff. **Holds.**
3. **Tried to break it.** The reader who took "the run" for the recompute now cannot; the remaining readings in the baseline ④.3 (interim taken for the answer, gate looked for in the note) are unchanged. No must-fix found.

**Check-runs on this head** (API, at review time): 38 runs, 14 `success`, 16 `skipped` (the opt-in, matrix-placeholder, UI, build and dogfood rows a docs-only diff filters out), 8 still running (Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Type Check · source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Test Core 1/8), 0 red; Check Changeset had not yet reported on this head. Green: Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Auto Label, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, the three scoped lints, Type Check · workspace, Test UI, filter. At `ff701a6e` the same families were all green or still running with 0 red. Landing precondition ② (every check green) stays the dispatching seat's to confirm once the running jobs conclude; the delta is one prose line in a file no built or tested package reads, and nothing read here predicts a red.

Should-fix (non-blocking, prose only): baseline (b) from 6675745144 remains open as stated there (the header's Evidence line does not account for this note's reading; the PR body's "earlier Open-item notes amend none of them either" is not true of the 2026-11-04 batch).

- **Shape:** one file, +25/−0: one hunk under ADR-0144 Open item 13 in `docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md`. That matches claim 6675374172. Governed (`docs/adr/**`), so this lands at Tier H.
- **Contract review:** PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, record 6675813461 at this head, with no must-fix. The delta from the earlier PASS 6675745144 at `ff701a6e` is one sentence: should-fix (a), applied verbatim, which binds "no organization's `localization.currency` is read" to the backfill alone.
- **What the note records:** ruling 6670707546 on #8345 (letter C) and the tree facts PR #30737 landed at `e2bcd5c1`. B is recorded in one sentence with no gate named. The four shapes not chosen carry the ruling's own reasons, the item-5 interim is recorded as an interim, and the item stays open on its B half.

The header's Evidence line does not name the `1371b9d8` reading, and the PR body's "its earlier Open-item notes amend none of them either" holds for the 10-30 and 10-31 notes but not for the 11-04 batch (`b7075d99`). Neither changes what the note records. Both ride the next ADR-0144 note batch.
